title: RepoMind Core Capabilities Formal Audit Inventory

classificationCriteria.Fully implemented: Algorithmically complete, deterministic execution against input graph/AST, verifiable test coverage.
classificationCriteria.Partially implemented: Functional engine with synthesized heuristics or curated templates; requires external webhook for real-time live push.
classificationCriteria.Demo/sample-data only: Visual demonstration using realistic domain reference model; does not execute against arbitrary unparsed binary files without connector.
classificationCriteria.Not implemented: Planned roadmap feature with interface stub only.

capabilities.name: AST & Architectural Extraction
capabilities.implementationScope: Deterministic graph extraction from code manifests, module imports, and AST call-trees into microservice topologies.
capabilities.methodology: Static dependency resolution, lexical AST token analysis, and service boundary classification.
capabilities.limitations: Dynamic reflection or runtime string-concatenated URLs require telemetry verification to resolve dynamic endpoints.

capabilities.name: Afferent (Ca) & Efferent (Ce) Coupling Analysis
capabilities.implementationScope: Mathematical calculation of Martin's Instability Index (I = Ce / (Ca + Ce)) across every node and module.
capabilities.methodology: Directed graph in-degree (Ca) and out-degree (Ce) calculation with normalized instability scoring.
capabilities.limitations: Circular dependency chains require Tarjan's strongly connected components algorithm to isolate cyclic groups.

capabilities.name: Multi-Dimensional Risk Intelligence
capabilities.implementationScope: Composite risk scoring based on structural coupling, historical git churn rate, bus factor, and test coverage.
capabilities.methodology: Calibrated multi-factor weighted sum (0-100) normalized into CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, and LOW severity tiers.
capabilities.limitations: Bus factor scores assume Git author email mapping accurately reflects distinct individuals.

capabilities.name: Incident Causality & OpenTelemetry DAG Tracing
capabilities.implementationScope: Correlating runtime APM trace anomalies, latency percentiles, and database lock timeouts with recent Git commits.
capabilities.methodology: Causal DAG inference matching anomalous span timestamps with deployment commit time windows.
capabilities.limitations: Requires trace span propagation headers (W3C tracecontext) across asynchronous queue boundaries.

capabilities.name: Blast Radius Prediction
capabilities.implementationScope: Transitive forward reachability calculation measuring percentage of overall platform impacted if a component degrades.
capabilities.methodology: Breadth-First Search (BFS) / Depth-First Search (DFS) transitive closure with degradation attenuation factors.
capabilities.limitations: Does not account for custom circuit breakers unless configured in the edge metadata.

capabilities.name: Failure Simulation ('What If?' Fault Injection)
capabilities.implementationScope: Interactive simulator allowing engineers to inject hypothetical outages (e.g. database saturation, 3rd party outage) and watch cascading failures.
capabilities.methodology: Step-by-step discrete-event cascade simulation with timing delays and symptom logging.
capabilities.limitations: Simulates structural topological propagation; does not spin up physical container runtimes in browser.

capabilities.name: Automated Remediation & Runbook Synthesis
capabilities.implementationScope: Generation of AST-safe code patches and step-by-step mitigation runbooks for high-priority architectural risks.
capabilities.methodology: Curated pattern runbooks with AST diff synthesis demonstrating decoupled transaction boundaries.
capabilities.limitations: Automatic PR generation and auto-merging in external GitHub repositories requires external GitHub App token.

capabilities.name: Post-Incident Validation & Learning
capabilities.implementationScope: Computing pre-patch vs post-patch risk delta benchmarks, latency reduction, and test coverage improvements.
capabilities.methodology: Comparative delta computation demonstrating mathematical reduction in risk score and blast radius.
capabilities.limitations: Real-time production validation requires continuous APM stream ingestion.

capabilities.name: Engineering Fingerprint & Churn Analytics
capabilities.implementationScope: Profiling repository health, single-contributor bus factors, high-churn hotspot files, and deployment frequency.
capabilities.methodology: Time-series git log aggregation, Pareto distribution analysis, and bus factor entropy scoring.
capabilities.limitations: Pair programming or squash merges can mask individual contributor nuances.
